name: Competitions and seasons
description: Which seasons exist and what the provider covers for each.

name: Teams and venues
description: Teams taking part in each enabled competition this season.

name: Fixtures
description: The full fixture list and kickoff changes for the current season.

name: Results and match details
description: Scores, events, lineups and statistics for matches that are live, just finished, or about to start.

name: Grading and settlement
description: Grades predictions and settles recorded bets once a result is confirmed; re-grades if the provider corrects a score.

name: League tables
description: A dated snapshot of each competition's table, for competitions with a result since the last one.

name: Squads
description: Each team's current squad; players leaving or joining are recorded with dates.

name: Player profiles
description: Birth date, nationality and height for players not yet profiled, a batch at a time.

name: Injuries and suspensions
description: Players reported missing or doubtful, for competitions with a match in the next four days.

name: Past seasons
description: Fixtures and match details for earlier seasons. Run by hand; paced to stay inside the daily quota.

name: Backtest
description: Re-runs the model for past matches as of the morning of each match day, a slice at a time. Feeds Model Performance and calibration. No provider requests.

name: Calibration and learned model
description: Refits the calibration for each market, trains the learned challenger and snapshots performance, every six hours. No provider requests.

name: League catalogue
description: Every league and cup API-Football covers, so any of them can be switched on in Settings. One request a week.
